summary: Teva Pharmaceutical Industries Ltd. filed an 8-K on September 14, 2026 disclosing the start of NYSE trading of its ordinary shares in place of American depositary shares (ADSs) under the same ticker, TEVA. The ADS program terminated that day, with each ADS exchanged for one ordinary share. Ordinary shares continue trading on the Tel Aviv Stock Exchange under TEVA. No board recommendation, advisor, stake, price, premium, or closing condition is stated. This is a routine depositary-receipt structure change, not a special situation; no arbitrage angle applies.
